rules.text: The salary cap is $155M. A team may sign a free agent only if its payroll after the signing is at or below the cap, unless the signing uses the minimum exception (R6).

rules.title: Trade salary matching
rules.text: In a trade, if a team's payroll after the trade is above the cap, the salary it takes in must be no more than 125% of the salary it sends out plus $0.1M. Draft picks carry no salary.

rules.title: Hard apron
rules.text: The hard apron is $196M. No transaction may take a team's payroll above the apron. A team that is already above the apron may only make transactions that reduce its payroll.

rules.title: Roster limits
rules.text: No transaction may leave a team with more than 15 players. A team must finish the day with at least 13 players.

rules.title: Trade restriction
rules.text: A player whose contract carries a no-trade clause or an active trade restriction cannot be included in any trade.

rules.title: Minimum exception
rules.text: A team over the cap may sign a free agent for exactly $2.3M if it has an open roster spot. The player must accept: a free agent asking more than $2.3M declines a minimum offer.

rules.title: Waivers
rules.text: Waiving a player removes him from the roster immediately. If his contract is guaranteed, his salary for this season stays on the team's payroll as dead money. Non-guaranteed salary is cleared. A waiver cannot be undone.

rules.title: Luxury tax
rules.text: The luxury tax line is $188M. Payroll above the line is taxed. The tax line is not a hard limit; only the apron (R3) is.

rules.title: Draft picks
rules.text: Draft picks may be traded. A team may not trade away its own first-round picks for two consecutive years; it must keep at least one of them.
